captions.detailed: A modern five-reel casino cabinet featuring a sleek black frame, a broad display face, a shallow front control deck, and a rear maintenance panel. Five grey cylindrical reels rotate continuously on parallel horizontal shafts behind the main display window. A rectangular grey spin button on the control deck translates prismatically in its guide sleeve, while the rear maintenance panel is hinged on a vertical revolute joint at one edge of the cabinet.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a modern five-reel casino cabinet in CadQuery. It should feature a black main cabinet body with a front display window and control deck, five parallel horizontal cylindrical reels that rotate continuously, a rectangular spin button on the control deck that translates vertically, and a rear maintenance panel with a handle that rotates on a vertical hinge.
captions.factory: The code constructs the cabinet body using a combination of box primitives for the main housing, side panels, and control deck. Five cylinders are instantiated on parallel horizontal coordinate axes to represent the spinning reels. The spin button is modeled as a small box with a vertical prismatic joint constraint. The maintenance panel is built as a flat box with an offset handle, attached to the main cabinet frame via a revolute joint along its vertical edge.
